description: Languages spoken by country: every language with its share of the population, approximate speakers and official status (official, de facto, regional) for 249 countries and territories, incl. all 54 African countries (e.g. Nigeria 17 languages, Kenya 19) and India (48). Also population and literacy. Source: Unicode CLDR 48.2 territory data. For localisation, translation and support planning. Returns JSON with asOf, count, results. Read-only; invalid input is rejected before any charge. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet), paid only when the call succeeds.

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country codes, comma-separated, up to 60 (default: all 249 countries and territories)
